rerank_helps_bm25.note: Positive delta means CLIP rerank of BM25 top-K beat caption BM25. Fusion RRF is a separate ablation and is off in the product default.

note: Protocol A: held-out caption-as-query pair retrieval, split by PMCID. Query is the figure caption with PDB / UniProt / RefSeq tokens stripped. Gold is that figure id. clip_image_only is T→I over the eval gallery; captions never enter the image encoder. caption_bm25 is lexical captions. vision_rerank reorders BM25 top-K by CLIP cosine (K=50 unless overridden). fusion RRF is an ablation and is OFF in the product default.

published_ranges.scimmir_clip_ft_hits@10_t2i: ~0.135 (ALL, different 530k gallery; not a target to match)

holdout.note: Queries are captions from the query-paper split. Those papers are absent from the 80% index-paper set. Eval gallery mode decides whether query-paper images are included as retrieval candidates.
